spots.name: Aspirantes de la Nave
spots.blurb: You've reached Aspirantes de la Nave, a mural. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Mural by Martín Ron
spots.blurb: This mural is by Martín Ron, painted in 2021. Un niño que intenta remontar su globo pinchado en forma de corazón es un mural de 30 metros de alto sobre la medianera de un edificio de 15 pisos.

spots.name: Una niña con legos y un globo
spots.blurb: You've reached Una niña con legos y un globo, a mural by Martín Ron from 2021. Una niña con legos y un globo es un mural de 65 metros de alto sobre la medianera de un edificio de 25 pisos.

spots.name: Escudo Club Temperley
spots.blurb: You've reached Escudo Club Temperley, a graffiti piece. It shows Escudo del Club Atlético Temperley. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
